activity.notes: Second term of Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj as Prime Minister of Mongolia, 20 August 2004–13 January 2006.

sources.title: Mongolia: Issues for Congress — Congressional Research Service
sources.citation_text: The CRS profile identifies Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj as a leader of Mongolia's democratic revolution, twice prime minister—briefly in 1998 and again in 2004–2006—and president beginning in 2009, reelected in 2013.

sources.title: Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj
sources.citation_text: The compiled office chronology gives exact terms as prime minister from 23 April to 9 December 1998, prime minister from 20 August 2004 to 13 January 2006, and president from 18 June 2009 to 10 July 2017.
